stem: Which of these statements best expresses the difference in tone between the quotations?

options.label: A
options.text: The first quotation is sincere, while the second is arrogant.

options.label: B
options.text: The first quotation is grave, while the second is passionate.

options.label: C
options.text: The first quotation is observational, while the second is introspective.

options.label: D
options.text: The first quotation is playful, while the second is mocking.

visual_elements: He is also keeping an eye on the staff, insisting on their impeccability in service—guiding his superbly honed institution of compassion with a glance, a word, a silent presence, a smile.
I find it easier to live with myself if I try to be honest.
